subject.title: fix: discord exec approvals fails against local self-signed TLS gateway

question: Should maintainers repair/review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80204 as the shared-bootstrap TLS fingerprint fix, or replace it with a clean equivalent?
rationale: The remaining work changes certificate fingerprint trust routing for Gateway clients, and the active PR is conflicting with prior review blockers, so maintainer security-boundary judgment is needed before landing.

options.title: Repair and review the active PR
options.body: Resolve the conflict/import blocker in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80204 and review the shared TLS resolver semantics before merge.

options.title: Replace with a clean successor
options.body: Open a narrow replacement that preserves the same shared-bootstrap fix intent if the active branch remains hard to reconcile.

options.title: Hold for TLS policy redesign
options.body: Keep this issue open without landing until maintainers revisit local, remote, CLI, and env TLS pin precedence as a broader policy decision.

recommendation.title: Repair and review the active PR
